answer: Each identity must craft a crystal lattice proof: the beacon emits a new falcon-seeded challenge per epoch, and the agent must embed a matching jade-hued hash in its response. The first layer requires 10k memory-hard iterations; every subsequent layer doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at depth 14 (81.9 M iters). The protocol audits each layer against the epoch seed; any gap or reorder voids the chain. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full tower cost because every lattice binds to a unique identity key—no shared work across clones.
